comment: Hard grader considering this is the very first level English course. She grades with a C being average which really isn't a fair system considering you need a C in order to pass the course. She puts a lot of emphasis on peer editing and small projects like reading reports. I wouldn't recommend her for this class or any other.

Professor Evans is a very nice lady who seems to enjoy teaching. She is a tough grader, but as long as you complete all the work, you will pass. An A is almost impossible to achieve on an essay but she gives small quizzes and reading reports that are much easier to get an A on

she is not a bad teacher, but not a great teacher either. class discussions are not intellectually stimulating; they're pretty basic. she is a tough grader because she grades on a scale of 1-16. her rubric has four sections that are worth 4 points each, so if you lose one point, you're down to an A- and if you lose three points, you're down to a B-

She is a good teacher and directs good class discussions, but she is a hard grader. Put some serious thought and work into your essays because she really does consider C to be average. Make sure she knows who you are and she is very nice and very helpful.

Absolutely dreaded going to her class. The essays are very manageable, however, very time-consuming. She does reward and acknowledge quality work, and she could tell how much time you spent on your paper. Make sure you listen to ALL the comments she writes on your first drafts; it's her way or the highway. You do what she says and you do it right a

Prof. Evans is actually quite a nice teacher. She is a tough grader, and has specifics in mind in grading. If you work hard, she will reward you. Expect a bad grade on the first paper. Write lots of drafts, work hard on peer-edits. She's hard at first, but she has a nice side. A is pretty tough, but you can struggle for a B+ or A-...
